card.name: The word date in "to date"
card.fires_on: The word "date" completing the phrase "to date", as in "has not been reported to date". It also fires weakly on "day" in similar time phrases such as "one day" and "six-day".

modes.label: to date
modes.description: "date" ends the phrase "to date" after a statement that something has or has not been reported or found.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of econazole nitrate in humans has not been reported to<< date>>.

modes.label: day in time phrases
modes.description: "day" appears in phrases like "one day" or "six-day".
modes.example: even though it is the environment that will decide all our fates one<< day>>.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese word endings and fragments, so there is no clear output effect beyond a weak push toward word endings.
